label: PF Backlog 612
title: Defect: no independent AC-verification gate + no closure guard - items can be closed 'completed' with AC unmet or self-verified

brief.what_adds: A real independent-verification gate + a write-time guard on status->completed
brief.problem: Closing an item is self-asserted: no independent-verification gate and no closure guard, so AC can be unmet at close

objective: Defect: no independent AC-verification gate + no closure guard - items can be closed 'completed' with AC unmet or self-verified
acceptance_criteria: scripts/dev/backlog_verification_check.py FAILS when a DELIVERED item lacks independent verification (verifier != implementer); registered in config/ci-cd-gates.json + scripts/dev/precheck.py fast tier (amended: merge_gate_check governs PR/validation evidence, not item-level AC)
The backlog API status->completed path REJECTS closing when acceptance_criteria is missing, or verification/evidence is missing, or verified_by is missing or equals worker_id
Evidence: closing an item without verified_by is rejected (HTTP 400) and accepted once verified_by differs from worker_id; the gate returns OK/FAIL accordingly

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/guardrails.py + core/defect_loop.py to add an independent AC-verification gate (verifier != implementer; each AC resolved with evidence) and a closure guard on /items/{id}/accept that rejects 'completed' when any AC is unverified. Reuse run_guard/merge_gate wiring; add policy entries in config/guardrail-policy.json and config/ci-cd-gates.json.

analysis.rationale: Items can be closed 'completed' with unmet or self-verified ACs; enforcing an independent verifier plus a closure guard on accept closes the integrity gap while reusing the existing gate architecture.
